query: INSERT INTO artist_alias (artist, alias, alias_key, locale, script, kind, source, is_primary) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'musicbrainz', $7) ON CONFLICT (artist, alias_key) DO UPDATE SET alias = EXCLUDED.alias, locale = EXCLUDED.locale, script = EXCLUDED.script, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary
